Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: fictional Korean web-drama casting visual, an individual portrait photograph, NOT a collage, NOT a contact sheet. Contemporary realistic Korean domestic suspense drama '삭제된 11초'. Original fictional adult, no celebrity likeness. Single person only, vertical portrait framed from just above head to below waist with hands and wrists visible, looking toward the camera, neutral relaxed pose. Pale warm-gray plain studio background, soft neutral daylight, realistic skin pores and matte cotton texture, restrained photographic color, clear eyes and face, no beauty retouching, no text, no labels, no watermark, no extra people.
Subject fixed design: Korean male police officer in his forties, composed professional expression, contemporary South Korean police service uniform suggested: light blue-gray short-sleeved uniform shirt with dark navy shoulder tabs and dark navy trousers, neat short black hair, clean-shaven. No hat, no weapon in hands, no prominent readable badges or text. Provisional uniform concept, no claim of exact insignia accuracy.
Distinct casting identity: Separate casting person D: narrow angular face, subtly defined jaw, deep-set hooded eyes, prominent long nose, thin lips, measured mature impression.
Cast a visibly distinct individual through these facial proportions; do not normalize to a generic fashion-model face. Keep age range, hair and costume in the fixed design. One individual photo only.

recovered_note: 중단된 실행의 도현 3장을 파일에서 복구. A~C 표기는 육안 결과를 보고 부여; 각 파일과 실행 당시 정확한 프롬프트의 대응은 미확인.
